text: {"lessons":["My account ended at 102,481, below its initial 105,005 despite periods of recovery, so I should judge progress over the full record rather than focus on any one month.","Doing nothing avoided impulsive reactions, but I should still review whether my holdings and risk remain appropriate instead of treating inaction as a plan.","Since I rarely check the account, I should use each review to assess the overall portfolio and make any changes deliberately, not trade just because prices moved."]}
